summary: Volunteer Park checked on its own pages and its Firefly booking engine (one quote): $54.99 (water/electric) and $59.99 (full hookup) for a 23-ft motorhome on a December 2026 weeknight, the off-season, so the cheapest real night is over the US$50 gate with no Good Sam, member discount or gateway; a large long-term share; Google 4.1/479. DROP CANDIDATE on price.
flags: PRICE GATE - DROP CANDIDATE: the cheapest RV night quoted is '$54.99 avg per night' (30 AMP WATER AND ELECTRIC ONLY O/P, 12/09/2026 weeknight, 23-ft Class C, 2 adults), plus a 2.75% card fee; full hookups '$59.99'. Not a Good Sam Park (discounts.good_sam false stands); no member discount posted on its pages; gateways.py: none within 40 km (GSMNP 53 km). Only one date could be quoted (the next two searches hit Firefly's 'Recaptcha' error and were not pushed), so a cheaper season was not seen; December is normally the off-season. The inclusion_evidence's 'RV Life $$ (avg $39)' is not borne out by the operator's engine.

LONG-STAY: the home page says 'a mix of short-term visitors and long-term guests' and 'some choose to make Volunteer Park their long-term home'; the ground rules carry monthly-payment terms. The engine lists 29 short-term RV units (site numbers run to 100+), 7-10 of them free on December nights, so the nightly share is roughly a third or less (not measured exactly). Nightly guests are not discouraged and there is no standing minimum. A second reason to drop alongside the price, not one on its own.

RIG LENGTH: 19 of the 29 short-term units carry a minimum rig length (31-36 ft) a 23-ft rig fails; it can book 10 (two water/electric, one 30-amp FHU, seven pull-throughs 80/85-88/90/100, rated 25-35 ft).
GOOGLE 4.1 (479 reviews); phone 865-938-6600 matches (no change); website https://volunteerpark.com/ fine. Inclusion evidence names volparktn.com, which now redirects to volunteerpark.com.
DISCOUNTS: military true is stored (not re-confirmed: no military rate on the park's pages or in the one quote); good_sam false stands.
